build_dataset: build a dataset from a registered name using config and split arguments
build_dataset_train_split: build a training dataset by passing the dataset name config and train split
build_dataset_val_split: build a validation dataset by passing the dataset name config and val split
register_dataset: register a new dataset class with the DATASET_REGISTRY for use with build_dataset
review_DATASET_REGISTRY: review the DATASET_REGISTRY to see which dataset builders are currently registered
